Single definition powers: UI, agent tools, HTTP endpoints, MCP, A2A invocation, CLI. Gains schema validation, native renderers, deep links, action-declared UI components. Replaces per-surface duplication.

opportunities.title: Embed Yjs CRDT for Multi-Agent & Human Collaboration
opportunities.description: Use Agent-Native's Yjs+presence layer for real-time sync of shared Chronica objects (workflows, holdings, strategies). Agents see live edits, can apply patches incrementally, maintain awareness of peer actions. Gains: conflict-free merging, live cursors, selective presence (who's editing what). Directly supports federation vision.

opportunities.title: Use Agent-Native MCP Server as Federation Gateway
opportunities.description: Expose Chronica capabilities via Agent-Native's MCP server (build-server.ts, connect-route, oauth-route). Enable external agents (Claude, Cursor, VS Code) to invoke Chronica actions, query holdings, trigger workflows. Gains: standard MCP tooling, OAuth integration catalog, cross-agent discovery. Proven production MCP.

opportunities.title: Adopt A2A for Cross-Agent Handoff & Delegation
opportunities.description: Use Agent-Native's A2A client/server (agent-to-agent invoke, continuations) for Chronica strategy-to-agent and agent-to-agent delegation. Enables tagged agent discovery (@strategy-name), zero-config cross-app auth via shared origin, continuation-based handoff. Replaces custom delegation with federated substrate.

opportunities.title: Adopt Provider API Abstraction for External Data Access
opportunities.description: Use Agent-Native's provider-api (corpus jobs, quota governor, staged datasets) as foundation for Chronica's external data queries (market feeds, venue data, LLM APIs). Agents submit safe provider queries without hardcoding each endpoint. Gains: quota governance, batch analysis, credential scoping.

opportunities.title: Adopt Agent-Native Observability for Traces, Evals, Feedback
opportunities.description: Use Agent-Native's observability/traces (JSON traces, user feedback, evals framework) for Chronica agent audit trail, mechanism performance evals, live feedback loops. Agents log decisions, humans provide labels, evals track improvement. Live feedback without external APM.

opportunities.title: Adopt Dispatch as Multi-Tenant Workspace Control Plane
opportunities.description: Integrate Agent-Native Dispatch package (@agent-native/dispatch) for Chronica: workspace vault (secrets), provider integrations lifecycle (OAuth tokens, credentials), destination routing, cross-app delegation. Replaces custom secrets/integrations with production SaaS control plane.

opportunities.title: Use Agent-Native Jobs for Chronica Scheduled Routines
opportunities.description: Adopt Agent-Native's job scheduler (cron, frontmatter, resumption) for Chronica routine execution (market checks, position updates, rebalancing triggers). SQL-backed, resumable, integrates with agent harness. Gains: declarative jobs, resumption across restarts.

opportunities.title: Port Chronica UI to Agent-Native Client Stack
opportunities.description: Migrate Chronica frontend to Agent-Native's client libraries (useActionQuery/Mutation, application-state, chat/collab components). Gains: automatic UI/agent sync via shared actions, built-in CRDT widgets, agent chat sidebar, request context (identity, caller). Agent-first UI design.

opportunities.title: Use Agent-Native Desktop & Mobile App Shells
opportunities.description: Deploy Chronica via Agent-Native's Electron desktop app and React Native mobile shell. Same action/agent contract runs on web, desktop, mobile. Gains: zero-config local-first SQLite, offline sync, push notifications, platform-specific integrations.

opportunities.title: Normalize Chronica Schema to Drizzle ORM with Multi-Driver Support
opportunities.description: Audit Chronica schema, adopt Drizzle ORM patterns from Agent-Native (table builders, migrations, dialect agnostic). Enable Postgres + SQLite + D1 (Cloudflare) without schema rewrites. Gains: portability, cloud-agnostic, ORM ecosystem.

opportunities.title: Absorb Flue's durable workflow engine into chronica-workflows
opportunities.description: Flue's run streams, submission journals with turn-by-turn durability, lease-based recovery after interruption, and compaction strategy (safe history truncation) are a direct upgrade to Chronica's workflow isolation. Key: money activities already gate through policy.evaluate_gate; Flue adds interruption recovery + replay without re-evaluation. Integrate event-stream persistence, durable submission model, and recovery routing into chronica-workflows. Scope: Phase 0 absorbs run/submission/journal model; Phase 1 integrates with chronica-approvals for human-gated money restarts.

opportunities.title: Migrate integrations to Flue's verified channel pattern
opportunities.description: Flue provides verified webhook ingress for 20+ platforms (Slack, Discord, GitHub, Stripe, Linear, Zendesk, etc.) with exact-byte signature verification, retry deduplication, and platform-native event types. Chronica's current integrations (helpdesk, commerce-signals, etc.) use ad-hoc HTTP handlers. Align chronica-integrations to Flue's channel abstraction: one createXxxChannel(...) per platform, verified payload, and idempotent handler routing. Scope: Phase 0 wraps top 5 platforms; Phase 1 completes 20.

opportunities.title: Integrate Flue's OTLP tracing into chronica-traces
opportunities.description: Flue's OpenTelemetry adapter maps workflow/operation/turn/tool/task/compaction lifecycle events to spans, with semantic conventions for GenAI turns (token usage, cost accounting) and sensitive-content redaction. Chronica-traces currently lacks OTLP export and span structure. Integrate: span mapping from Flue events, token/cost roll-ups, content redaction policy, and Tempo/Grafana export. Enable export of structured tracing (run_id + event indexes) for distributed workflow debugging across federated holdings.

opportunities.title: Adopt Flue's database adapter pattern in chronica-core
opportunities.description: Flue's adapter contract (bring-your-own-driver; transaction wrapper; collection schema definition; concurrent-safe leasing) is cleaner than Chronica's current sqlx-direct approach. Flue supports Postgres, MongoDB, LibSQL, MySQL, Redis without bundling drivers. Implement: adapter trait in chronica-core, port Postgres/MongoDB adapters as reference, enable Chronica to work offline with file-backed SQLite or with any user-chosen DB. Scope: Phase 0 abstracts Postgres; Phase 1 adds 2 more drivers.

opportunities.title: Enable packaged skill distribution via chronica-strategy
opportunities.description: Flue's skill packaging (SKILL.md frontmatter, base64 archive format, versioned imports) enables agent expertise to be versioned, published, and imported by name. Chronica's capability market (federation peers sharing strategies) can use this pattern: publish packaged skill to registry, import into agent via skill ID + version, and maintain backwards compatibility. Scope: design skill registry contract, create publish/consume endpoints, enable skill versioning and peer-to-peer distribution.

opportunities.title: Adopt Flue's React SDK in chronica-browser for agent UI
opportunities.description: Flue's @flue/react hooks (useFlueAgent, useFlueWorkflow) and SDK client provide live chat UI with optimistic messaging, streaming deltas, tool-call progress, and Durable Streams replay. Chronica's browser runtime can adopt these to support agent conversation UI, workflow inspection dashboards, and live federation peer queries. Scope: integrate @flue/react as optional dependency, create Chronica-branded agent chat component.

opportunities.title: Extend chronica-runtime tools with Flue's defineTool pattern
opportunities.description: Flue's defineTool with schema generation and MCP bridging enables tools to be versioned, remapped, and introspectable without re-deploy. Adopt Flue's tool registration, schema inference, versioning metadata, and dynamic routing so agents can discover tool availability and admins can migrate/deprecate tools live.

opportunities.title: Extend chronica-cli with Flue's multi-target deployment
